method: 512 fixed seeds: ASTERION then stage30-map-1..511. Independent adjacency/BFS/bridge/cut/refinement calculations inspect actual serialized states. Coordinate-independent signatures are diagnostics, not a fun score or a proof of graph isomorphism. No end turns, played campaigns or new win-rate sample. Paid founding and knowledge mutations are separately labeled controlled command drills.

uiSelection.ruleA: First declared seed whose Concord ore prospect requires Ecology, ordinary worlds within2 <=2, and recovery is at least2 jumps away.
